sessions.title: Repository foundation (turn 1), operations desk foundation and first slice (turn 2), hosting plan and Claude agent lab (turn 3)
sessions.agent: Claude Code (cloud session) for Paul Phillips
sessions.summary: Unpacked and audited the launch packet; installed and verified the toolchain; built dev log, delivery tracking, validators, CI and the Pages project hub; researched current vendor facts; wrote the foundation planning brief for the next turn's plan mode. Turn 2 (v0.2.0): built the operations desk foundation (SC-005) and its first vertical slice (SC-006 pitch intake with source and rights records, SC-007 editorial queue with Ghost references, first part of SC-009 agent gateway) on local Supabase, with database policy, unit, end-to-end, accessibility and bundle-secret tests. Turn 3 (v0.3.0): verified hosting and running costs (Supabase Pro plus Cloud Run and Cloud Storage), proposed ADR-004 for automated Ghost drafts with one-click human publishing, added a production container image with a CI smoke test, and built a Claude-powered agent lab whose real runs wait for an API key.
